rclone_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the rclone binary executable.

rclone_config_file.description: Absolute path to a custom rclone.conf file. Leave empty to use the default location.

minimize_to_tray.description: Whether to minimize the window to the system tray on startup.

show_notifications.description: Whether to show system notifications when background tasks complete.

media_player.description: Command to launch the external media player for streaming.
